tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sgrub pa'i thabs kun las btus pa dngos grub rin po che'i 'dod 'jo'i glegs bam bcu bzhi'i dkar chag bzhugs so//

༈ glegs bam dang po (ka)pa'i dkar chag (nang gses sde tshan mang po yod/) 001 (ka)rgyal ba tshe dpag tu med pa dkar po'i sgrub pa'i thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa la/ mdzad pa po/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ gzim 'og slob ma gu ṇa pa/ dge slong mai tri karma gu ṇa/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po bcas so// 002 (ka)sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i chos skor gyi yi ge rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa la/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon chen po ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pad+ma nag po/ ba ri lo tsās bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ mañdzu gho ṣa/ ban+de blo gsal/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dbang phyug rab brtan/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa skya pa kun blo/ ngag dbang legs grub dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po bcas so// 003 (ka)paṇ+ḍita chen po sa man+ta shrī nas brgyud pa'i dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor la/ mdzad pa po/ sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal/ ga ga na shrī bha dra/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ gzim 'og sprul sku byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phrin las/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang*/ byams pa kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bcas so// 004 (ka)ring 'tsho'i cho ga sgrub pa'i rnam par bzhag pa 'chi bdag slu ba'i rtog pa'i don 'grel tshe dbang dga' ba 'khyil pa'i thig le/ mdzad pa po/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'o// 005 (ka)tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs kyi lo rgyus dbang chog sgrub thabs dang bcas pa'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ shangs sgom rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ ban+de blo gsal dang*/ bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po bcas so// 006 (ka)ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo'i lugs kyi tshe dpag med kyi dbang chog mdzad pa po/ ngag gi dbang po/ ga ga na shrī bha dra dang*/ bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po bcas so//

007 (ka)dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gser chos lugs kyi tshe dpag med sprul sku'i sgrub thabs bum chog rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan 'phags pa dang*/ btsun pa kun dga' lhun grub bcas so// 008 (ka)rgyal dbang stag lung pa chen po'i zab chos las 'byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa sprul sku'i dbang chog gsar bu dga' skyed/ mdzad pa po/ byang stag lung pa dge slong ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub bo// 009 (ka)ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo nas brgyud pa'i tshe dpag med dkar po'i sgrub thabs dbang chog man ngag dang bcas pa bdud rtsi'i bum bzang*/ mdzad pa po/ bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 010 (ka)tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma'i nyams len gyi rim pa 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud len/ mdzad pa po/ btsun pa blo gsal dang*/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 011 (ka)tshe sgrub zab mo rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa/ mdzad pa po/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen dang*/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 012 (ka)'chi med rang gzungs su grags pa sgra mi snyan gyi tshe sgrub zab mo'i rjes gnang bya tshul/ mdzad pa po mi gsal/ 013 (ka)'chi med rang gzungs zhes bya ba lus srung ba'i rig sngags kyi sgom bzlas/ mdzad pa po/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen/ ngag dbang legs grub dang*/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang po bcas so// 014 (ka)sgra mi snyan gyi tshe sgrub zab mo'i skor rnams/ mdzad pa po/ dbu ru stod kyi dge slong dharma kīrti dang*/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 015 (ka)nye brgyud tshe rta zung 'brel 'chi med dpal ster gyi sgrub thabs dbang chog man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ rje grub chen/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ blo gter dbang po/ mañdzu gho ṣa dang*/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang po bcas so// 016 (ka)bka' gter dag snang zung du 'brel ba'i tshe sgrub shin tu nye brgyud kyi sgrub thabs dbang chog dang bcas pa/

mdzad pa po/ grub thob chen po dang*/ chos rje gling pa'o// 017 (ka)gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i rtog pa'i ṭī ka sgrub thabs stong mchod rjes gnang gi cho ga sogs chos skor tshang ba/ mdzad pa po/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ dpal ldan don grub/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po bcas so// 018 (ka)rig pa rma bya chen mo'i sgo nas rdo rje'i tshe sgrub la sogs kyi gdams zab 'chi med dūrba'i ljon bzang*/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 019 (ka)nges brjod bla ma'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i 'chi med rdo rje lha mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dge slong kun dga' bzang po dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po bcas so// 020 (ka)skra dang sen mo la sogs pa sreg pa'i cho ga bde legs nyi ma/ mdzad pa po/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen dang*/ bya bral ba mañdzu gho ṣa'o// 021 (ka)bzang po spyod pa'i cho ga'i sgo nas 'chi ba slu ba'i gdams ngag gsal byed dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ mañdzu gho ṣa'o// 022 (ka)rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i cho ga la brten nas brtan bzhugs 'bul tshul dbang bcu grub pa'i dga' ston/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 023 (ka)bsun zlog gi cho ga mdor bsdus pa grub pa'i zhal lung*/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 024 (ka)rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo la brten pa'i 'chi slu'i cho ga ring 'tsho'i dpal ster/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 025 (ka)rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo la brten pa'i bla slu'i cho ga ring 'tsho'i bcud len/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 026 (ka)'phags ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo la bstod pa tshe dang ye shes mchog sbyin/

mdzad pa po/ tshangs sras dgyes pa'i blo ldan nam mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// ༈ glegs bam gnyis pa (kha)ba'i dkar chag 027 (kha)rigs gsum spyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga phrin las lhun grub/ mdzad pa po/ dge slong ga ga na shrī bha dra dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 028 (kha)'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i rtog pa dang dpa' bo gcig pu grub pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i 'jam dpal dkar po'i sgrub thabs/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las so// 029 (kha)paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti nas brgyud pa'i 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ lo rtsa ba byams pa'i dpal/ rgya ston/ spos khang pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ brang btsun nam mkha'/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 030 (kha)'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sgom bzlas 'phags pa bzhad pa'i rol gar/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mī'o// 031 (kha)rje btsun dam pa rgya gar nas brgyud pa'i 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ ka ma la shī la/ ban+de dpal grub/ mañdzu gho ṣa/ dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang legs grub dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 032 (kha)ngag gi dbang phyug smra ba'i seng ge'i sgrub thabs snyan pa'i rol mo 'khrol ba gzhon nu rnam par rol pa/ mdzad pa po/ blo gros mtha' yas/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang*/ a rā gas so// 033 (kha)rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dmar ser gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ sa paṇa/ sa skya lo tsā/ ga ga na shrī bha dra/ ban+de shrī ming can/ mañdzu gho ṣa dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 034 (kha)chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dang 'jam dbyangs dmar ser sbags te sgrub pa'i thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa'i skor/

mdzad pa po/ sangs rgyas dpal/ ngag dbang chos grags/ kun dga' tshul khrims/ ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 035 (kha)maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma/ mdzad pa po/ chos rgyal 'phags pa'o// 036 (kha)paṇ+ḍi ta gser gdugs can nas brgyud pa'i 'jam dpal shes rab 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ kun dga' lhun grub dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 037 (kha)'jam dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po'i bstod pa sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ tshar chen chos rje/ shāka btsun lhun grub dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 038 (kha)mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ lo tsā rin chen grags pas bsgyur/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 039 (kha)'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'don thabs gsal byed dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 040 (kha)bram ze phur bu'i lugs kyi dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ bram ze phur bu/ drang srong mngon shes can/ bsam yas pa tshul khrims blo gros/ 'gyur med rdo rje dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 041 (kha)sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ bi dza ming can no// 042 (kha)dbyangs can dkar mo'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa shes rab kyi snang ba rgyas byed ces bya ba/ mdzad pa po/ btsun pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dpal lo// 043 (kha)bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal nas brgyud pa'i dbyangs can dkar mo'i sgrub thabs gegs sel rjes gnang bstod pa dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'jigs med grags pa/

dbyangs can dga' ba/ paṇ+ḍi ta nag mo'i khol/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 044 (kha)dbyangs can ma'i sgom bzlas tam+bu ra'i dbyangs snyan/ mdzad pa po/ bstan pa'i nyin byed do// 045 (kha)dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ gu ṇa pa/ bya bral lhun grub/ paṇ+ḍi ta dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 046 (kha)bo dong lugs kyi dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub lha lnga'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa 'jigs bral dgyes pa'i lam srol/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 047 (kha)paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī la nas brgyud pa'i mi g.yo ba dkar po'i sgrub skor/ mdzad pa po/ paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī la/ yar lung pa yon tan khri/ btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 048 (kha)rdo rje phag mo dkar mo shes rab gsal byed kyi sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon koṅka dā t+ta/ dgo slong shrī mān ming can/ dpal ldan don grub/ rin chen rnam rgyal/ mañdzu gho ṣa dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 049 (kha)thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa brgyud pa'i khyad par gnyis ldan gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ lhan cig rol pa/ 'phags pa/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan don grub/ slob dpon zla grags/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang*/ ma ṇi pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs so// 050 (kha)shes rab kyi lha rnams kyi rjes gnang skabs su gleng bar 'os pa'i gtam nyung ngu bdud rtsi'i dbyangs snyan/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// ༈ glegs bam gsum pa (ga)ba'i dkar chag 051 (ga)thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len tshul rjes gnang dang bcas pa/

mdzad pa po/ 'phags pa/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen/ btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 052 (ga)grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po la thugs rje chen pos dngos su gnang ba'i snying po yi ge drug pa'i nyams len gyi gzhung gsal byed dang bcas la/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' grol mchog blo gros mtha' yas dang*/ thang stong rgyal po'o// 053 (ga)'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ dge slong ma dpal mo/ bsod nams seng ge/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang*/ mañdzu gho ṣa'o// 054 (ga)bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs rigs bzhis bskor ba'i rjes gnang gi cho ga gzhan phan zla snang*/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 055 (ga)bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs mkha' 'gro lnga bskor gyi rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga gzhan phan zla zer/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'am ma ṇi pas so// 056 (ga)dge slong ma dpal mo'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub thabs smyung gnas dang bcas pa'i cho ga sdig sgrib rnam sbyong*/ mdzad pa po/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen dang*/ btsun pa thogs med do// 057 (ga)maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa tshom bu bdun pa/ mdzad pa po/ 'phags pa'o// 058 (ga)theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong rang gis len pa'i cho ga mdzad pa po/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub bo// 059 (ga)'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don yod zhags pa'i sgrub skor rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ ngag dbang chos grags so// 060 (ga)'phags pa spyan ras gzigs don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs gso sbyong dang 'brel ba'i cho ga sgrib 'joms ye shes chu rgyun/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas so// 061 (ga)dpal phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi gzungs sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa'i skor/

mdzad pa po/ grags pa rgyal mtshan no// 062 (ga)dpal phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can 'gro bzang lugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po dang*/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen no// 063 (ga)dpal phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 064 (ga)dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed me dbang ma/ mdzad pa po/ rab 'byams pa rin chen bzang po'o// 065 (ga)dpal phyag na rdo rje u tsār+ya'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ dkon mchog lhun grub dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 066 (ga)dpal phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa'i yi ge rdo rje'i me phreng*/ mdzad pa po/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'o//

067 (ga)dpal phyag na rdo rje drag po gsum sgril gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ las kyi rdo rje/ skal bzang rgya mtsho dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 068 (ga)bla ma rigs gsum mgon po'i thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i gsol 'debs mos gus kyi dbyangs snyan/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 069 (ga)sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs bum chog rjes gnang gsal byed dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge/ dge slong sangs rgyas rin chen/ btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ bud+dha la k+ṣ+mis/ dā ri maṅga la/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen dang*/ dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs so// 070 (ga)mang mkhar ba blo gros bzang pos phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i lo rgyus sgrub skor rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ mang mkhar ba blo gros bzang po'o// 071 (ga)sgrol dkar nye brgyud kyi gsol 'debs 'chi med bdud rtsi'i do shal/ mdzad pa po/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang*/ dge 'dun grub pa'o// 072 (ga)paṇa chen shākya shrī'i lugs kyi sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa bdud rtsi'i thig le/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 073 (ga)sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa dmigs rim dang bcas pa sogs yig cha nyer mkho 'chi med bdud rtsi'i zil dngar/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 074 (ga)lha mo shra ba ṇa'i sgrub skor/ mdzad pa po/ paṇ+ḍi ta bkra shis rnam rgyal dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 075 (ga)slob dpon zla ba'i bshes gnyen nas brgyud pa'i rmi lam lung ston sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon zla ba'i bshes gnyen dang*/ mañdzu gho ṣa'o// 076 (ga)bud+dha tsu ru ka'i skye ba brtag pa'i gdams ngag gzhung gsal byed dang bcas pa dri bral nor bu'i me long*/

mdzad pa po/ mchims nam mkha' grags dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 077 (ga)rje btsun sgrol ma nyin zhi mtshan khro'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 078 (ga)rje btsun sgrol ma 'jigs pa kun sel gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang bya tshul/ mdzad pa po/ btsun pa ngag dbang brtan pa'o// 079 (ga)jo bo lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ jo bo rje a ti sha dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 080 (ga)rje btsun sgrol ma la gsol ba 'debs pa maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ shāka btsun lhun grub dang*/ bya bral ba kun dga' lhun grub bo// 081 (ga)sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga bya tshul mdor bsdus snying por dril ba phan bde'i ut+pal/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 082 (ga)kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī'i lugs kyi sgrol ma ljang gu'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī'o// 083 (ga)rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma la gsol ba 'debs pa thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i sgra dbyangs/ mdzad pa po/ ban+de dpal grub bo// ༈ glegs bam bzhi pa (nga )ba'i dkar chag 084 (nga )dpal kye rdo rje lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 085 (nga )dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon dus zhabs pa dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 086 (nga )dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ sangs rgyas grags/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 087 (nga )dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs/ mdzad pa po/ chos 'phags dang*/ blo gros mtha' yas so// 088 (nga )dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyun bshags rgyas pa/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon bhu ba ri pas so// 089 (nga )rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ma ti/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ kun dga' bzang po/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ga ga na shrī bha dra dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 090 (nga )rgyal chen in+d+ra bhū ti'i lugs kyi rdo rje phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ ngag dbang chos grags dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 091 (nga )grub chen mai tri ba'i lugs kyi mkha' spyod rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon gnyis med rdo rje/ kun dga'i ming can/ kun dga' smon lam dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 092 (nga )dpyal lugs phag mo skor gsum gyi sgrub thabs byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ rje btsun grags rgyan dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 093 (nga )grub chen dpal 'dzin pa'i lugs kyi rdo rje phag mo khros ma dmar mo lha gsum ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon dpal 'dzin dang*/ mañdzu gho ṣa'o// 094 (nga )khros ma nag mo gsang sgrub kyi gtor dbang dngos grub dpal ster/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 095 (nga )dpal ma hā mā yā gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ tā ra nā tha dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 096 (nga )dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/

mdzad pa po/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 097 (nga )sgrub thabs rgya mtsho las byung ba'i gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 098 (nga )dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 099 (nga )dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ btsun pa ā nan+da nir bho ga dang*/ mañdzu gho ṣa'o// 100 (nga )grub chen mi tra dzo ki'i lugs kyi 'phags pa thugs rje chen po sems nyid ngal bso'i sgrub rjes man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ mi tra dzo ki/ mi trā ā nan+da dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 101 (nga )thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga'i sgrub thabs gtor dbang las tshogs dang bcas pa'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po/ dge slong dkon mchog 'bangs/ pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas/ blo gros mtha' yas dang*/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'o// 102 (nga )chos rje rin po che'i thugs dam sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ bla ma karma pa/ tā ra nā tha/ 'gyur med rdo rje dang*/ 'jam mgon bstan pa'i nyin byed do// 103 (nga )'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'chi med grub ster la sogs/ mdzad pa po/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho dang*/ blo gros mtha' yas so// 104 (nga )dge ba can ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe khrid dpal ldan mar me mdzad kyi lugs gtsang la ma 'dres pa bdud rtsi'i za ma tog mdzad pa po/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'o// 105 (nga )sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i rgyun khyer dam tshig nges pa'i thig le/

mdzad pa po/ ku sā li yon tan rgya mtsho'o// 106 (nga )slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi thugs dam gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 107 (nga )slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa blo gsal nyer mkho/ mdzad pa po/ btsun pa kun dga' lhun grub/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ nyi sbas dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 108 (nga )lha mo sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig la bstod pa rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon sūr+ya gup+ta dang*/ mañdzu gho ṣa'o// 109 (nga )rje btsun sgrol ma btson 'don ma'i bsnyen sgrub kyi cho ga man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon nyi sbas/ grags pa rgyal mtshan dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 110 (nga )'phags ma sgrol ma bkra shis don grub ma'i sgrub thabs bkra shis char 'bebs/ mdzad pa po/ ku sā li blo gros mtha' yas so// ༈ glegs bam lnga pa (ca)ba'i dkar chag 111 (ca)bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'o// 112 (ca)thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug 'khor dang bcas pa'i phyag mchod rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ dge slong nam mkha' grags dang*/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen no// 113 (ca)thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug bcas la phyag mchod gsol ba gdab ba'i cho ga thub bstan rgyas pa'i dpal yon kun 'byung*/ mdzad pa po/ ngag dbang blo gros gzhan phan mtha' yas so// 114 (ca)rten 'brel snying po'i gzungs dang 'brel ba'i srung ba zab mo'i byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ dge slong ner ban rak+ṣi ta/ sa skya pa chen po/ chos rje pa paṇa dang*/

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 115 (ca)nor bu bstan pa spyi dbang bya thabs chos spyod bcu nyams su len tshul dang bcas pa bstan pa'i tshal 'byed/ mdzad pa po/ tā'i si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// 116 (ca)mdo sde zab mo 'don pa'i gdams ngag 'ga' zhig phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon mar me mdzad/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta/ dge slong sgra tshad pa/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 117 (ca)sangs rgyas sman bla mched bdun gyi rjes gnang bya tshul bklag chog don grub bsam 'phel/ mdzad pa po/ bhik+ṣu ga ga na bha dra/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ mañdzu gho ṣa dang*/ dharma bha dra'o// 118 (ca)sman bla'i mdo chog snying po gzhan phan bde 'jug mdzad pa po/ blo gsal bstan skyong ngo*// 119 (ca)sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi mchod pa'i cho ga'i snying po nyams su len tshul 'di phyi'i re smon kun 'grub/ mdzad pa po/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 120 (ca)sman bla'i mdo chog gzhan phan bde 'jug gi zur rgyan kun phan ut+pal gzhon nu'i 'khri shing*/ mdzad pa po/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*/ blo gros mtha' yas so// 121 (ca)bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med 'khor dang bcas pa mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa'i cho ga thar pa'i shing rta/ mdzad pa po/ karma pa de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'o// 122 (ca)bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa'i cho ga 'brel tshad don ldan/ mdzad pa po/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'o// 123 (ca)jo bo lugs kyi mi 'khrugs pa gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ zhang ston pa dang*/ mañdzu gho ṣa'o// 124 (ca)jo bo lugs kyi mi 'khrugs pa'i las tshogs nyer mkho btus pa las sgrib rgyun gcod/ mdzad pa po/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'o// 125 (ca)bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor/

mdzad pa po/ klu sgrub/ bcom ral/ rong ston/ shāka btsun lhun grub/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang*/ dpal sa skya pa'o// 126 (ca)klu dbang rgyal po'i char 'bebs byin rlabs dpal ster/ mdzad pa po/ dge slong dpal ldan chos skyong ngo*// 127 (ca)slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i klu dbang rgyal po'i bum gter sgrub tshul gsal bar bkod pa/ mdzad pa po/ 'phags pa klu sgrub dang*/ blo gter dbang po'o// 128 (ca)bka' gdams lha bzhi'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ ngag dbang chos grags dang*/ yon tan rgya mtsho'o// 129 (ca)bka' gdams lha bzhi'i nyams len thar lam sgron me/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 130 (ca)rdo rje gdan pa'i chos drug mdzad pa po/ rdo rje gdan pa'o// 131 (ca)'phags ma 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ 'phags pa/ dbang phyug rab brtan/ blo gsal bstan skyong dang*/ sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros so// 132 (ca)lha mo 'od zer can ma'i man ngag mdor bsdus pa'i yi ge 'jigs pa'i mun sel/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 133 (ca)mi g.yo ba sngon po'i lo rgyus sgrub skor las tshogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ bsod nams rtse mo/ mi g.yo ba'i rgyud las/ btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub dang*/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 134 (ca)dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i zab chos gsang sgrub skor gsum gyi sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ mkha' 'gro ma nai gu ma/ bla ma shangs pa/ chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ blo gsal ri khrod pa'o// 135 (ca)dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i thun mong gi las sgrub pa'i lha gsum las khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ btsun pa blo gsal bstan skyong ngo*// 136 (ca)dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i thun mong gi las sgrub pa'i lha gsum las sna tshogs yum dkar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/

mdzad pa po/ bu ston/ btsun pa chos grags dpal dang*/ blo gsal bstan skyong ngo*// 137 (ca)dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i thun mong gi las sgrub pa'i lha gsum las 'dab chags mgon po rdo rje nam mkha' lding gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ shes rab rgyal mtshan dang*/ btsun pa blo gsal bstan skyong ngo*// ༈ glegs bam drug pa (cha)ba'i dkar chag 138 (cha)dpal kyai rdo rje'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gur gyi las rgyas pa'i lha gsum las/ phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ rdo rje gur rgyud las/ btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ dpal ldan don grub dang*/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen no// 139 (cha)dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi bstod pa/ mdzad pa po/ 'phags pa rin po che dang*/ gzim 'og bstan 'dzin snyan grags so//

140 (cha)dpal gsang ba'i bdag po 'byung po 'dul byed gyi sgo nas las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bya tshul dngos grub nor bu 'dren pa'i gru chen/ mdzad pa po/ gzim 'og sprul sku bstan 'dzin phrin las so// 141 (cha)dpal kye rdo rje'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gur gyi las rgyas pa'i lha gsum las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ rdo rje gur rgyud las/ grags rgyan/ sa chen/ kun dga' bzang po/ rong ston/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang*/ mañdzu gho ṣa'o// 142 (cha)sher phyin yi ge gcig ma'i gzhung gsal byed dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ dpal sa skya pa/ stag lung pa bkra shis dpal/ khro phu lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal lo// 143 (cha)dpal kye rdo rje'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gur gyi las rgyas pa'i lha gsum las/ so sor 'brang ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ grags rgyan/ kun dga' bzang po/ dkon mchog lhun grub dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 144 (cha)dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka'i bsgom bzlas yan lag dang bcas pa byin rlabs zla zhun gyi chu bo/ mdzad pa po/ wā gin+d+ra su sid+dhi'o// 145 (cha)bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i bsnyen sgrub phrin las dang bcas pa'i yi ge dngos grub 'dod 'jo/ mdzad pa po/ blo gros mtha' yas so// 146 (cha)bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje'i sgom bzlas sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ rje btsun grags rgyan/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros dang*/ wā gin+d+ra su sid+dhi'o// 147 (cha)sdig ltung sbyong ba dam tshig rdo rje'i sgom bzlas dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg gi rgyud rtsa 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ rje bdag nyid chen po tsong kha pa'o// 148 (cha)dam tshig rdo rje'i sgom bzlas bya tshul tshigs bcad dag byed bdud rtsi'i khrus chab/

mdzad pa po/ blo gsal bstan skyong ngo*// 149 (cha)rdo rje mkha' 'gro la brten pa'i sdig sbyong sbyin sreg gi cho ga sgrib gnyis kun 'joms/ mdzad pa po/ blo gros mtha' yas so// 150 (cha)rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgo nas gson gshin gyi sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i cho ga thar pa'i snang 'byed/ mdzad pa po/ blo gros mtha' yas so// 151 (cha)bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje sogs la smre bshags kyis gsol ba gdab pa thugs dam gnad nas bskul/ mdzad pa po/ wā gin+d+ra su sid+dhi'o// 152 (cha)sngags kyi ltung ba phyir bcos pa'i thabs nyer lnga gsal bar bkod pa nor bu ke ta ka'i phreng ba/ mdzad pa po/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'am/ blo gros mtha' yas so// 153 (cha)byang chub sems dpa'i ltung ba bshags pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa byin rlabs kyi gaṅgā bzang po/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 154 (cha)'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po sgrub thabs bzlas lung las tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ shākya rak+ṣi ta/ slob dpon dpal mar me mdzad/ blo gros mtha' yas so// 155 (cha)so thar gyi bshags sdom zhi gnas gso sbyong dang 'brel pa nyes ltung dag byed gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ mdzad pa po/ blo gros mtha' yas so// 156 (cha)gza' thams cad kyi yum rje btsun rig pa chen mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang mchod chog dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ 'phags pa/ bstan rdor dang*/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen no// 157 (cha)gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ mdzad pa po/ bcom ldan 'das so// 158 (cha)'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi/ bsod nams rtse mo/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ dpal ldan don grub dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 159 (cha)seng ge sgra'i sgo nas gdon sgrol gyi cho ga rin chen phreng mdzes zhes bya ba nag po 'gro shes su bkod pa/

mdzad pa po/ ngag dbang blo gros snying po gzhan phan mtha' yas dang*/ bud+dha sak+ṣ+mi'o// 160 (cha)bum gter gzhug pa'i man ngag gsal byed dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ bla ma sa skya pa dang*/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs so// 161 (cha)dpal sa skya pa'i gser chos 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i ngag srung 'grol gyi gdams pa zab mo/ mdzad pa po/ rje btsun sa skya pa dang*/ ban+de blo gsal lo// 162 (cha)thugs rje chen po'i mig 'byed mnga' bdag nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyi gter byon gsal byed dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ shrī bkra shis stobs rgyal dang*/ mañdzu gho ṣa'o// 163 (cha)rje btsun ri khrod ma ser mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ thar rtse paṇa chen dang*/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros so// 164 (cha)rje btsun ri khrod ma'i man ngag nyer mkho dge legs snang gter/ mdzad pa po/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// ༈ glegs bam bdun pa (ja )ba'i dkar chag 165 (ja)sna tshogs pa'i las rab tu 'byung ba 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig pu grub pa'i rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dpal rdo rje/ dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ blo gros rgyal mtshan dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 166 (ja)rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs bum chog rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ bya bral ba/ btsun pa nam mkha'i ming can/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen dang*/ ngag dbang legs grub bo// 167 (ja)gtor chen gyi lo rgyus dang cho ga mdzad pa po/ ā nan+da yis so// 168 (ja)rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la nye bar mkho ba'i cha gsum gtor ma/ mdzad pa po/ kun dga' bzang po dang*/ dkon mchog lhun grub bo// 169 (ja)rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs/ mdzad pa po/ rig 'dzin grags dang*/ brang ti pas so// 170 (ja)khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa sa lugs kyi sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/

mdzad pa po/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' lhun grub dang*/ bsod nams lhun grub bo// 171 (ja)jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i sme brtsegs ljang nag gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ bha dan+ta ga ga na shrī bha dra dang*/ sa skya pa kun blo'o// 172 (ja)khro bo rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa gtsang byed tshangs pa'i zla shel/ mdzad pa po/ rin chen chos rgyal dang*/ kun dga' snying po'o// 173 (ja)mkha' 'gro ma sme ba brtsegs ma'i bum pa'i cho ga nyams grib mthar byed/ mdzad pa po/ ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ mañdzu gho ṣa dang*/ blo gsal bstan skyong ngo*// 174 (ja)khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sgrub thabs las sbyor rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ kīrti dh+wa dza'o// 175 (ja)khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa grub pa'i zil dngar/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 176 (ja)khrus lha lnga'i sgrub thabs bkru byab srung ba rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa dri ma kun sel/ mdzad pa po/ bya bral ba bud+dha'i ming can no// 177 (ja)bcom ldan 'das ma sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sgrub thabs kyi rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ rje bdag nyid chen po/ mañdzu gho ṣa/ tshul rin/ rje btsun sa skya pa dang*/ blo gter dbang po'o// 178 (ja)rten khrus ri khrus sogs kyi cho ga nyes pa kun sel/ mdzad pa po/ ngag dbang blo gros snying po gzhan phan mtha' yas so// 179 (ja)'jam dpal nag po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// gser chos/ mdzad pa po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 180 (ja)jo bo lugs kyi srung ba'i lha mo lnga'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o//

181 (ja)srung ba'i lha mo lnga la brten nas byad 'grol ba'i cho ga dag gsal mdor bsdus te bkod pa/ mdzad pa po/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'o// 182 (ja)'phags ma so sor 'brang ma'i 'khor lo'i man ngag don thams cad yongs su grub pa mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/ mdzad pa po/ 'phags pa dang*/ blo gter dbang po'o// 183 (ja)tshe sgrub 'chi med bu ston gong khug ma/ mdzad pa po/ btsun pa blo gsal bstan skyong ngo*// 184 (ja)shākya rak+ṣi ta'i lugs kyi lha mo rnam rgyal ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ shākya rak+ṣi ta dang*/ blo gter dbang po'o// 185 (ja)'phags pa ngag gi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ yar klung lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan dang*/ blo gter dbang po'o// 186 (ja)ni ri ti pa'i lugs kyi 'phags pa byams pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon ni ri ti pa/ gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 187 (ja)rje btsun byams pa mgon po la mchod pa'i cho ga dang 'brel bar dga' ldan du sems bskyed pa'i smon lam nor bu'i them skas/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 188 (ja)khro phu lo tsā ba chen po byams pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa'i smon lam rin po che sil ma/ mdzad pa po/ khro phu lo tsā'o// 189 (ja)khro phu lo chen byams pa'i dpal gyi gsung rab las byung ba'i dngos grub kyi rdzas nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi mchod phreng 'dod rgu'i sprin chen/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 190 (ja)rje btsun byams pa mgon po la bsngags pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dad pa'i me tog mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 191 (ja)'phags pa byams pa mgon po la bstod pa yid bzhin nor bu'i sprin phung*/ mdzad pa po/ gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal lo//

192 (ja)paṇa chen zla ba gzhon nu'i lugs kyi dbyangs can ma dkar mo phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon zla ba gzhon nu/ lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 193 (ja)dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i cho ga rin po che'i do shal/ mdzad pa po/ ga ga na shrī bha dra'o// 194 (ja)rgyal ba g.ya' bzang pa'i khyad chos dpal phyag na rdo rje nyi ma mdung gang ma'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ pad+ma gar dbang dang*/ sngags btsun phrin las lhun grub bo// 195 (ja)phyag na rdo rje gtum po khyung lnga'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa'i lag len rab tu gsal ba/ mdzad pa po/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs so// 196 (ja)rta mgrin dmar po grub rgyal lugs kyi sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ rgyal khams pa tshar chen dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 197 (ja)mnyam med jo bo chen po nas brgyud pa'i rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ mkhan po dpal mar me mdzad/ rta mgrin shā na bzhi bskor rgyud las dang*/ blo gter dbang po'o// 198 (ja)snye mo gter ston rgya gangs ri bas spyan drangs pa'i rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi chos skor tshang ba/ mdzad pa po/ pad 'byung*/ rig pa 'dzin pa blo gsal/ za hor gyi sngags btsun che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/ pad+ma phrin las dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 199 (ja)byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan nas brgyud pa'i dpal rta mgrin nag po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan dang*/ brang ti ga ga na shrī bha dra'o// 200 (ja)rta mgrin nag po zla rgyal lugs kyi gtor zlog rdo rje'i me char/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// ༈ glegs bam brgyad pa (nya)ba'i dkar chag

201 (nya)bla ma zhi ba gsang ba 'dus pa'i gzhung rtsa ba phrin las cha lag dang bcas pa'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ 'gyur med rdo rje/ bi dza ya dang*/ mañdzu gho ṣa'o// 202 (nya)slob dpon pad+ma ka ra dang bla ma dbyer med du sgrub pa'i thabs thar lam nying khu/ mdzad pa po/ pad+mas rjes bzung ban+de/ tshar chen blo gsal/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dang*/ gzim 'og bstan 'dzin phrin las so// 203 (nya)slob dpon pad+ma'i gsol 'debs bsam pa myur 'grub ma/ mdzad pa po/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams so// 204 (nya)gu ru drag dmar nyang lugs 'bring po me'i spu gri'i sgrub rjes man ngag dang bcas pa'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ rgyal sras dri med 'od zer/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen dang*/ blo gter dbang po'o// 205 (nya)khyung khra'i sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ gdung brgyud phyag dpe las zhal bshus dang*/ bya bral ba lhun grub bo// 206 (nya)bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khyung khra'i sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ sngags 'chang gzungs dpal/ bzang po'i ming can/ 'phags pa/ gzungs pa'i ming can dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 207 (nya)dus 'khor lugs kyi khyung khra'i 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris/ mdzad pa po/ dpe ris rnams bcug dgos// 208 (nya)ye shes khyung nag gi sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ shar sbu chu ba dpal ldan grags pa/ bud+dha lak+ṣ+mi/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang*/ wā gin+d+ra su sid+dhi// 209 (nya)khyung nag me yi spu gri 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes/ rje blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma dang*/ gu ge yongs 'dzin gyi zin bris las so// 210 (nya)ye shes kyi bya khyung dmar po'i sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang gi tho yig dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ pad+ma thod phreng rdo rje'o//

211 (nya)mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi man ngag zab mo/ mdzad pa po/ bla ma sa skya pa nas brgyud pa/ mkhan chen char pa/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug ga ga na shrī bha dra/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 212 (nya)dpal sa skya pa'i gser chos mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i rjes gnang las tshogs mngon rtogs shin tu zab pa'i gdams pa/ mdzad pa po/ gong lugs so// 213 (nya)seng gdong sngon mo gtso 'khor gsum ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa rdo rje'i sprin char/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 214 (nya)seng gdong rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa phrin las rnam rol/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 215 (nya)mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi gtor ma la brten nas phyir zlog pa'i man ngag snying po dgra bgegs dpung 'joms/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 216 (nya)mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can ba ri lugs kyi bum chog byad 'grol gyi yi ge shel gyi sbur len/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o//

217 (nya)seng gdong ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i dbyangs snyan/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 218 (nya)bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gzungs bklag thabs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ btsun pa blo gsal bstan skyong dang*/ grub chen las kyi rdo rje'o// 219 (nya)bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar can gyi sgo nas byad 'grol bya tshul gsal ba'i sgron me/ mdzad pa po/ btsun pa lhun grub bo// 220 (nya)bcom ldan 'das gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sgom bzlas kyi man ngag sreg byed me'i 'khor lo/ mdzad pa po/ dge slong rin chen chos rgyal dang*/ ban+de tshul rin no// 221 (nya)khro bo'i rgyal po gtsug tor 'bar ba'i gtor ma la brten nas phyir zlog pa'i gdams pa bar chad kun sel/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 222 (nya)rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal byed/ mdzad pa po/ bcom ldan 'das/ bla ma sa skya pa dang*/ blo gter dbang pos phyogs bsdebs pa'o// 223 (nya)gnod pa phyir zlog pa la mchog tu bsngags pa bha ya nā sa ni'i gdams ngag gsal byed dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ sa chen/ mnga' ris rab 'byams pa tshul khrims 'od zer ro// 224 (nya)rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon lhan skyes rol pa/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ kun blo'i gsung la mañdzu gho ṣas mchan dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 225 (nya)rje btsun ma gu ru kul+le'i gsang sgrub lha lnga'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga gsal ba'i sgron me/ mdzad pa po/ ngag dbang chos grags so// 226 (nya)dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ 'phags pa rin po che dang*/

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 227 (nya)dpal 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje gdan pa/ dkon mchog lhun grub dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 228 (nya)gnyan lo tsā ba'i dbang gi lha gsum las/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa dbang du bsdus pa'i rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le dpal mo snying gi gser thag can du grags pa'i chos skor/ mdzad pa po/ sa skya pa chen po dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 229 (nya)dbang gi lha mo ti nu ma'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi man ngag gi yi ge yid 'phrog li khri'i chu gter/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 230 (nya)rje btsun sa skya pa'i man ngag dbang gi sgrol ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug rdo rje gdan pa bsod snyoms pa/ yar klung pa sing ha dh+wa dza bha dra/ btsun pa bsod nams/ dpal ldan don grub dang*/ wā gin+d+ra su sid+dhi'o// 231 (nya)rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+le'i dbang gi sbyin sreg gi cho ga gsal ba/ mdzad pa po/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho'o// ༈ glegs bam dgu ba (ta)pa'i dkar chag 232 (ta)rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras bde byed kyi rtog pa gser 'od 'bar ba'i gzungs/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po/ lha sa'i gter ma dang*/ blo gros dri med bu ston kha che'o// 233 (ta)phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzang lugs dang rnam thos sras kyi sgrub thabs dang gtor chog dgos 'dod kun 'byung*/ mdzad pa po/ dkon mchog lhun grub dang*/ bu ston rin po che'o// 234 (ta)jo bo lugs kyi dzam+bha la dkar po'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs/ mdzad pa po/ dī paṃ ka ra/ dpal ldan a ti sha/ she'u lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa kun blo dang*/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen no// 235 (ta)dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las byung ba'i gnod sbyin dzam+bha la ser po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/

mdzad pa po/ slob dpon zla grags/ dge 'dun grub pa dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 236 (ta)'phags pa dzam+bha la ser po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi/ sa skya pa chen po dang*/ dkon mchog lhun grub bo// 237 (ta)dzam+bha la dmar po'i srog sgrub kyi gdams pa rje sa chen gyi man ngag mdzad pa po/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ gong dkar rdor gdan/ lhun grub dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 238 (ta)'phags pa dzam+bha la dmar po gsung gi sgrub pa'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*/ dge slong pad phrin gyis btus so// 239 (ta)dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i dzam+bha la ljang gu'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ 'grel chen dri med 'od las dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 240 (ta)paṇa chen shākya shrī'i lugs kyi dzam+bha la nag po'i sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ gdubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal/ slob dpon nor sbyin/ slob dpon nor 'dzin dpal/ lo tsā ba rol pa'i rdo rje dang*/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi'o// 241 (ta)dzam+bha la nag po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po dang*/ dge slong dkon mchog lhun grub bo// 242 (ta)lha mo nor rgyun ma ser mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ ga ga na shrī bha dra/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang*/ mañdzu gho ṣa'o// 243 (ta)paṇ+ḍi ta dza mā ri'i lugs kyi 'phags ma nor rgyun ma ser mo'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ mañdzu gho ṣa'o// 244 (ta)dpa' bo gcig pu grub pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin dzam+bha la yab yum gyi sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ rgyud rgyal las phyung*/ grags rgyan 'grel pa las phyung ba dang*/

dkon mchog dpal ldan no// 245 (ta)gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu'i rig gtad gter bum sgrub thabs dang bcas pa 'dod rgu'i bum bzang*/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang*/ blo gter dbang po'o// 246 (ta)'phags pa tshogs bdag dkar po jo bo lugs kyi rjes gnang bya tshul gsal ba/ mdzad pa po/ dge slong she'u lo tsā ba'o// 247 (ta)dpal tshogs kyi bdag po chags pa'i rdo rje gtso 'khor bzhi'i rjes gnang gi phyag gzhes gsal ba'i sgron me/ mdzad pa po/ ngag dbang chos grags so// 248 (ta)dpal sa skya pa'i gdams ngag khyad par can nor lha dbyu gu ma mched gsum gyi man ngag gi skor/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa dang*/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams so// 249 (ta)dpal kye rdo rje gtso rkyang gi mngon rtogs ngag 'don snying po gsal ba/ mdzad pa po/ mañdzu gho ṣa'o// 250 (ta)dpal kye rdo rje gtso rkyang gi mngon rtogs/ mdzad pa po/ ngag dbang legs grub bo// 251 (ta)dpal kye rdo rje gtor chog mdzes rgyan/ mdzad pa po/ dkon mchog lhun grub bo// 252 (ta)gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlab/ mdzad pa po/ mi gsal/ 253 (ta)bzlas pa rdzogs pa'i rjes su/ mdzad pa po/ mi gsal/ 254 (ta)theg pa chen po'i smon lam/ mdzad pa po/ mi gsal/ 255 (ta)dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i bskor/ mdzad pa po/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang dang*/ shar pa kun dga' bkra shis so// 256 (ta)dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa/ mdzad pa po/ rak+ṣi ta dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta ga ga na shrī bha dra'o// 257 (ta)dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa dkar po tshe 'phel gyi sgo nas 'chi med sgrub pa'i gdams ngag zla ba'i bdud rtsi/ mdzad pa po/ shar bla kun dga' dpal ldan no// 258 (ta)dpal ye shes mgon po'i thugs sgrub mgon po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/

mdzad pa po/ klu sgrub/ slob dpon spyod mdzad rdo rje/ phag gru sku regs las phyung dang*/ ga ga na shrī bha dra'o// 259 (ta)dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ dpal shā wa ri dbang phyug dang*/ ngag dbang chos grags so// 260 (ta)dpal mgon legs ldan mched gsum la gtor ma 'bul ba'i cho ga bar chad kun sel/ mdzad pa po/ dpal ldan don grub bo// 261 (ta)dmag zor rgyal mo'i rjes gnang bya tshul/ mdzad pa po/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis so// 262 (ta)'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor ma'i rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa bsam 'phel nor bu/ mdzad pa po/ kun dga' lhun grub bo// 263 (ta)chos kyi rgyal po'i rgya gzhung la li ta badz+ra gyis mdzad pa/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon la li ta badz+ra/ rgya ston/ dkon mchog lhun grub dang*/ ngag dbang legs grub bo// 264 (ta)dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi gtor chog dang rjes gnang bya tshul gyi cho ga'i phyag len/ mdzad pa po/ dge slong sangs rgyas rin chen dang*/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen no// 265 (ta)bcom ldan 'das yang gsang khros pa yab yum rkyang sgrub kyi sgrub thabs rgyun khyer dngos grub myur stsol/ mdzad pa po/ pad+ma drag po rtsal lo// 266 (ta)pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa dpa' bo gcig pa/ mdzad pa po/ ban+de blo gsal rgya mtsho/ tshar chen no// 267 (ta)gnod sbyin lcam sring gi rjes gnang gi lag len khrig chags su bkod pa/ mdzad pa po/ ngag dbang chos grags dang*/ blo gter dbang po'o// ༈ glegs bam bcu pa (tha)ba'i dkar chag 268 (tha)lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs 'dod 'jo/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 269 (tha)thang rgyal lugs kyi bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi sgom lung mchod chog dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 270 (tha)bla ma don yod grub pa'i mchod chog bilba'i snye ma/

mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 271 (tha)bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' la brten pa'i bshags sbyong gi yi ge gi'u waṃ gi thig le/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 272 (tha)gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i smin byed kyi dbang rjes gnang sogs kyi sngon 'gro'i chos kyi gtam du bya ba gzhan phan rab ster/ mdzad pa po/ blo bzang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'o// 273 (tha)chos 'chad nyan bya tshul dang*/ dbang bskur rjes gnang sogs kyi rnam dbye blo dman nyams dga'/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po dang*/ blo gsal ri khrod pa'o// 274 (tha)yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga chos dang bsod nams rgyas byed/ mdzad pa po/ dge slong kun dga' bzang po'o// 275 (tha)chos spyod nyer mkho yan lag nyi shu pa yid bzhin nor bu'i them skas/ mdzad pa po/ mañdzu gho ṣa/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ byams chos bstod pa/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta/ wā gin+d+ra/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ mangs ris pa tshul khrims 'od zer/ rgyal sras thogs med/ dge slong seng ge'i mtha' can dang*/ blo gter dbang po'o// 276 (tha)gzungs sngags byin rlabs can 'don thabs dang bcas pa yid bzhin nor bu'i snying po/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang pos bsdebs so// 277 (tha)mchod sbyin tshogs gsog gi rim pa yid bzhin nor bu'i rgya mtsho/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon dza ya se na/ wā gin+d+ra/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ mañdzu gho ṣa/ ban+de tshul rin dang*/ 'phags pa dge legs rgyal mtshan dpal bzang ngo*// 278 (tha)rgyud sde bzhi'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge spyi 'gro dngos grub rin po che'i 'byung gnas/ mdzad pa po/ btsun pa lhun grub bo// 279 (tha)yi dam dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong rab 'byams kyi gtor chog skor phrin las 'dod 'jo/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 280 (tha)lha'i rnal 'byor phal mo che la sbyar rung sreg blugs kyi cho ga'i khog phub ngag 'don bcas rin chen gser gyi phra mig

mdzad pa po/ ngag dbang blo gros snying po gzhan phan mtha' yas so// 281 (tha)sbyin sreg bsdus pa phrin las rin po che'i 'byung gnas/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 282 (tha)rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa bkra shis rdzogs ldan gyi sprin phung*/ mdzad pa po/ ngag dbang legs grub/ wā gin+d+ra su sid+dhi dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 283 (tha)rab gnas mdor bsdus dge legs rin po che'i 'byung gnas/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 284 (tha)sāts+tsha 'debs pa'i cho ga dge tshogs rgya mtsho 'phel ba'i zla ba/ mdzad pa po/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen no// 285 (tha)lhag pa'i lha rab 'byams la sbyar du rung ba'i mchod phreng mchod sprin rgya mtsho/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 286 (tha)tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bsod nams rgya mtsho/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang*/ blo gter dbang po'o// 287 (tha)grub chen thang rgyal lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i ma ṇi ril sgrub gzhan phan kun khyab/ mdzad pa po/ grub chen gyi gsung ngo*// 288 (tha)'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don bya tshul snying por dril ba phan bde'i myur lam/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 289 (tha)'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ mdzad pa po/ btsun pa thogs med do// 290 (tha)bla ma dam pa'i gdung mchod dang*/ phal par lho sgo'i sgo nas phan gdags pa'i cho ga gzhan phan 'od snang*/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 291 (tha)tshe sgrub kyi cho ga sogs nyer mkho phan bde'i sprin phung*/ mdzad pa po/ chos rje gling pa su kha badz+ra/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ mañdzu gho ṣa/ dngul chu thogs med dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 292 (tha)'chi med bcud len gyi man ngag bkra shis zho yi snying po/ mdzad pa po/

blo gter dbang po'o// ༈ glegs bam bcu gcig pa (da)ba'i dkar chag 293 (da)gtsug gtor gdugs dkar can gyi 'khor lo bri thabs rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i cho ga dang bcas pa rig sngags grub pa nor bu'i snying po/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 294 (da)sa snying dang brtan ma sbrags sgrub kyi bum gter sgrub tshul phan bde'i yang snying*/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 295 (da)las kyi tshogs nyer mkho gces btus dngos grub rin po che'i rgya mtsho/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 296 (da)grub pa'i dbang phyug dza hā bhī ra'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa/ mdzad pa po/ lha btsun ngag dbang phun tshogs so// 297 (da)dpal sa skya pa'i man ngag las brgyud pa'i sbyin sreg bsdus pa'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ dpal sa skya pa'o// 298 (da)khro phu brgya rtsa las byung ba'i man ngag nyer mkho 'ga' zhig mdzad pa po/ chos rje lo tsā ba dang*/ lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal lo// 299 (da)dpal stag lung pa'i man ngag zab mo las cung zad btus pa/ mdzad pa po/ ban+de bkra shis dpal/ nā ro pa/ ma gcig rgyal mo/ bla ma sa skya pa dang*/ dpal stag lung pa thang pa bkra shis dpal so//

300 (da)grub chen khyung po'i mgur brgyad dang bka' rgya ma bzhi bcas/ mdzad pa po/ grub chen khyung po'o// 301 (da)rnam sras dkar po tshe 'phel gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ gzim 'og bstan 'dzin snyan grags dang*/ blo gsal bstan skyong ngo*// 302 (da)dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i bka' srung thun mong ma yin pa mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i skor tshang ba/ mdzad pa po/ khyung po rnal 'byor pa/ nam mkha' stobs rgyal/ blo gsal rgya mtsho/ grol mchog ngag dbang chos grags/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bud+dha lak+ṣ+miṃ dang*/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen no// 303 (da)shangs lugs mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rten la brten nas phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i cho ga rin chen don yod zhags pa/ mdzad pa po/ ngag dbang blo gros snying po gzhan phan mtha' yas so// 304 (da)bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa'i skor/ mdzad pa po/ dge bsnyen bho dhi rā dza/ mchog legs rdo rje dang*/ mañdzu gho ṣa'o// 305 (da)lha sman bkra shis tshe ring ma'i phrin las la brten nas tshe g.yang sgrub pa'i cho ga bkra shis gter mdzod/ mdzad pa po/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'o// 306 (da)bsngo smon shis brjod dang bcas pa'i skor dge legs bkra shis char 'bebs/ mdzad pa po/ bzang spyod smon lam/ bshad rgyud rtse mo/ zla ba sgron me'i mdo/ stong chen smon lam/ rma bya chen mo'i smon lam/ bcom ldan 'das so// 307 (da)sgrub thabs kun las btus pa'i smin grol yan lag dang bcas pa'i brgyud yig dge legs gaṅgā'i klung chen/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 308 (da)sgrub pa'i thabs kun las btus pa dngos grub rin po che'i 'dod 'jo'i dkar chag gi yi ge bkra shis grub pa'i chu gter/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs legs pa'i blo gros so// ༈ glegs bam bcu gnyis pa (na)ba'i dkar chag

309 (na)lhag pa'i lha rnams kyi sgrub thabs kun las btus pa ba ri brgya rtsa'i rgya gzhung*/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon sna tshogs las/ ba ri lo tsās brgyur ba'o// 310 (na)sgrub thabs so so'i yig sna/ mdzad pa po/ rje btsun chen po'o// 311 (na)sgrub thabs brgya rtsa nas bshad pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa'i tho yig mun sel sgron me/ mdzad pa po/ shākya'i btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub bo// 312 (na)ba ri ba'i chos skor gyi brgyud 'debs/ mdzad pa po/ mañdzu gho ṣa'o// 313 (na)dbang dang rjes gnang la sogs pa'i gong du gleng bar 'os pa'i chos gtam dbyar gyi rnga gsang*/ mdzad pa po/ mañdzu gho ṣa'o// 314 (na)rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi sgrub thabs cho ga rig gtad dang bcas pa ngo mtshar u dum+bā ra'i 'khri shing*/ mdzad pa po/ blo gros mtha' yas so// 315 (na)thub dbang dang nye ba'i sras brgyad kyi sgom bzlas dang lung 'bogs tshul byang chub spyod pa'i shing rta/ mdzad pa po/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho phrin las kun khyab bo// 316 (na)ston pa nye ba'i sras brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor gcig tu mchod cing bsags sbyong bya ba'i cho ga rgyal sras dgyes pa'i lam 'jug mdzad pa po/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'am/ blo gros mtha' yas so// 317 (na)thub pa'i dbang po dang nye sras brgyad kyi mtshan brgya'i bstod pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po sogs so// 318 (na)'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i rnam thar phyogs gcig gi cha shas la cung zad bsngags pa nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po dbyer med pa'i ye shes rgya mtsho/ mdzad pa po/ blo gros mtha' yas dang*/ yon tan rgya mtsho'o// 319 (na)bla med lhan skyes rnam bzhi'i sgrub thabs rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor/ mdzad pa po/ 'bri khung skyu ra'i rdor 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'o//

320 (na)bla med lhan skyes rnam bzhi'i rdzogs rim snying po don gyi phreng ba/ mdzad pa po/ 'bri dam pa chos phyug go/ 321 (na)rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sngags btu'i byin rlabs ji ltar bya ba'i tshul mchog thun dngos grub kyi bang mdzod/ mdzad pa po/ dge slong bstan 'dzin ming can no// 322 (na)dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sngags btu'i rjes gnang bya tshul rab gsal sgron me/ mdzad pa po/ dharma bha dra'o// 323 (na)dpal 'khor la sdom pa'i rin chen bzhi'i sngags btu'i rjes gnang bya tshul legs bshad gser gyi thur ma/ mdzad pa po/ dge slong dharma bha dra'o// 324 (na)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sngags btu'i rjes gnang bya tshul gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i snying thig mdzad pa po/ ban+de dharma bha dra'o// 325 (na)bla ma tshe lha rnam gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang rjes su 'brel bar tshogs gnyis spel ba'i cho ga 'chi med grub pa'i dga' ston/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mī/ ngag dbang grags pa/ 'brom ston dang*/ gzhon nu a bha ya'o// 326 (na)tshe lha rnams gsum la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'chi med grub pa'i gsang lam/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 327 (na)'phags pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ mdzad pa po/ bcom ldan 'das dang*/ 'phags mo sgrol ma'o// 328 (na)'chi med tshe lha rnam gsum dril te sgrub pa'i rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga 'chi med rtag pa'i thig le/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 329 (na)dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs cho ga dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ bud+dha rat+na dang*/ dpyal lo tsā chos bzang ngo*// 330 (na)sgrub thabs rgya mtsho nas bshad pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa'i tho yig gi don 'grel 'dod dgu'i ljon shing*/

mdzad pa po/ brang ti rigs skyes shākya'i btsun pa nam mkha' dpal bzang ngo*// ༈ glegs bam bcu gsum pa (pa)ba'i dkar chag 331 (pa)rigs gsum spyi'i rjes gnang gi cho ga srid zhi'i dge legs lhun grub/ mdzad pa po/ dpal ldan blo gros rgyal mtshan no// 332 (pa)rje btsun ma sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shis so// 333 (pa)srad rgyud lugs kyi ri khrod ma rigs gsum gyi sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin dang*/ shar mdo khams pa skal bzang mkhyen brtse'i ming can no// 334 (pa)dpal khrag 'thung chen po'i sgrub thabs yang dag par grub pa/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra'o// 335 (pa)dpal chen yang dag he ru ka'i snying po zla gam gcig ma la brten pa'i bsnyen pa dang rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bya ba'i yi ge thugs kyi thig le/ mdzad pa po/ pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas dang*/ blo gros mtha' yas so// 336 (pa)'khon lugs yang dag he ru ka'i don dbang grub gnyis 'dod 'jo/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 337 (pa)rdo rje phur pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi dum bu sogs 'khon lugs phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi skor rgyun khyer dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon pad+ma/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros so// 338 (pa)dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i rgyun gyi nyams len bya ba'i rim pa thugs kyi thig le/ mdzad pa po/ pad+ma gar dbang rtsal dang*/ pradzñā rasmi'o// 339 (pa)dkar bdud lcam dral gyi gtor chog dang rjes gnang bya tshul shin tu gsal ba/ mdzad pa po/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen no// 340 (pa)gter kha gong 'og gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ mdzad pa po/ pad+ma 'byung ngo*// 341 (pa)o rgyan rin po che'i gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub/ mdzad pa po/

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 342 (pa)bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i tshes bcu'i dus mchod dang 'brel bar byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang bskur/ mdzad pa po/ dge slong rig pa 'dzin pa mtsho skyes bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs so// 343 (pa)nyang lugs gu ru drag dmar gyi gtor ma'i las mtha' dgra bgegs srog gi spu gri/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 344 (pa)thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi rgyud gzhung sgrub thabs dbang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas dang*/ blo gros mtha' yas so// 345 (pa)rigs lnga'i bum sgrub/ mdzad pa po/ mi gsal/ 346 (pa)bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po'i las tshogs brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon pad+ma'o// 347 (pa)phyir zlog 'khor lo 'bar ba'i gzhung man ngag dang bcas pa'i skor rnams/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon pad+ma/ dge slong pad+ma phrin las/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang*/ mañdzu gho ṣa'o// 348 (pa)lha mo dpal chen mo'i sgrub thabs sgom lung man ngag dang bcas pa'i skor rnams/ mdzad pa po/ 'jam dpal rgyud las/ sngags 'chang rā ga a s+ya dang*/ blo gros mtha' yasaso// 349 (pa)dbyu gu mched gsum gyi sgrub thabs bklags pas grub pa yid bzhin nor bu'i za ma tog mdzad pa po/ bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub dang*/ blo gter dbang po'o// ('dir dpe ris yod/) 350 (pa)lha mo shrā ma ṇa'i sgrub tshul gsal bar bkod pa shel dkar me long*/ mdzad pa po/ btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me'o// 351 (pa)'phags ma so sor 'brang ma'i byis pa srung ba'i 'khor lo dmigs su gsal ba'i man ngag mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang pos bsgrigs pa'o// 352 (pa)chos spyod nyams len gyi rim pa rab tu gsal ba/ mdzad pa po/ dge slong dkon mchog 'bangs kyis bsdus so// 353 (pa)nyer mkho'i chos spyod mdzes rgyan nor bu'i snying po/

mdzad pa po/ bya bral ba mañdzu gho ṣa'o// 354 (pa)rab gnas kyi yon bsgo'i bshad pa legs bshad 'od kyi snye ma/ mdzad pa po/ shāka btsun lhun grub bo// 355 (pa)thugs rje chen po'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs lam rim smon lam dang bcas pa byin rlabs mchog stsol/ mdzad pa po/ mkhyen brtse dbang phyug dharma shrī dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 356 (pa)tshe sgrub nye brgyud kyi sgrub thabs 'chi med grub pa'i zhal lung*/ mdzad pa po/ blo bzang bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub bo// 357 (pa)'chi med tshe sgrub dbang chog don gsal sgron me/ mdzad pa po/ dge slong nam mkha'i ming can no// 358 (pa)dpal stag lung pa nas brgyud pa'i tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs longs sku dang sprul sku'i tshe dbang gi cho ga 'chi med grub pa'i zil dngar/ mdzad pa po/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 359 (pa)kun rig la brten pa'i rab tu gnas pa 'bring po'i cho ga phrin las rab tu rgyas byed/ mdzad pa po/ dge slong kun dga' lhun grub bo// 360 (pa)jo bo chen po'i thugs dam grong khyer ngan song las sgrol ba'i 'khor lo/ mdzad pa po/ jo bo chen po'o// 361 (pa)dpal snar thang pa'i mngon rtogs brgya rtsa/ mdzad pa po/ sna tshogs yin yang*/ mang ba dge slong nam mkha' grags kyis bsdebs so// 362 (pa)snar thang brgya rtsa las 'byung ba'i yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i yi ge 'dod 'jo'i ba mo/ mdzad pa po/ snar thang mkhan chen mchims nam mkha' grags kyis phyogs bsdebs las/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sbyar ba'o// ༈ glegs bam bcu bzhi pa (shrī)ba'i dkar chag 363 (shrī)'phags yul grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs skor las/ lo rgyus rnam par thar pa/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon dpa' bo 'od gsal gyis bsgrigs pa'o// 364 (shrī)grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rtogs pa'i snying po rdo rje'i glu/

mdzad pa po/ slob dpon dpa' bo 'od gsal gyis phyogs bsdus so// 365 (shrī)grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i do ha 'grel bcas/ mdzad pa po/ slob dpon dpa' bo 'od gsal gyis phyogs bsdus shing*/ bla ma a bha ya shrī'o// 366 (shrī)grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa mchog gi byin rlabs ye shes bcud sbyin/ mdzad pa po/ rgyal dbang 'brug pa'i mtshan can/ 'gyur med yongs grub chos kyi nyi ma'o// 367 (shrī)grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs yig cha ye shes bcud sbyin gyi lhan thabs mthong bas don rtogs/ mdzad pa po/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'o// 368 (shrī)grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rjes gnang bya tshul/ mdzad pa po/ bya bral ba mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'o// 369 (shrī)dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur mgon sprin zhabs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa nye brgyud thun mong ma yin pa/ mdzad pa po/ ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phun tshogs so// 370 (shrī)dpal mgon bram nag gam nag po dam 'chang*/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 371 (shrī)dpal mgon legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa'i gtor chog skong ba rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ mdzad pa po/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ brang btsun nam mkha' dpal bzang dang*/ wā gin+d+ra'o// 372 (shrī)mgon po bing dmar gyi gtor chog mdzad pa po/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ blo gsal bstan skyong dang*/ ban+de dbang rab bo// 373 (shrī)dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma'i phyi sgrub kyi gzhung mchog tu zab pa/ mdzad pa po/ bram ze mchog sred/ bla ma dam pa dang*/ dge slong sangs rgyas rin chen no// 374 (shrī)dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang thun mong ba/ mdzad pa po/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug dang*/ mkhyen rab chos rje'o// 375 (shrī)pu tra ming sring gi rjes gnang bya tshul/

mdzad pa po/ ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen no// 376 (shrī)dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po'i rgyud gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo/ mdzad pa po/ bla ma bai ro/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po'o// 377 (shrī)dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi bsnyen sgrub gsal bar byed pa'i gtam gyi rgyud mangs/ mdzad pa po/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen no// 378 (shrī)mgon po snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang bya tshul gyi skyid shod pa'i yig cha/ mdzad pa po/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'o// 379 (shrī)dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor rgyal mo'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam gzhag mdzad pa po/ mi gsal/ 380 (shrī)'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo'i sgrub thabs gtor chog mdzad pa po/ rje nyid dang*/ blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes so// 381 (shrī)srog bdag dmar po'i drag sngags shan pa sgrol byed kyi rgyud/ mdzad pa po/ shan pa'i rgyud las dang*/ blo gsal rgya mtsho'o// 382 (shrī)jo lugs dzaṃ dkar lha lnga'i phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i cho ga 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang po'o// 383 (shrī)mgon po dzam+bha la dmar po'i phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i cho ga pad+ma rā ga'i lcags kyu/ mdzad pa po/ blo gter dbang pos bsdebs so//

384 (shrī)bsngo smon bkra shis byin rlabs can gyi skor rnams bzhugs so// mdzad pa po/ grub dbang thang stong rgyal po'o// ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
